deadlines.notes: Listed as 'Start year intake 2027 - direct applications close' on the Bachelor of Science and Bachelor of Commerce international key dates. The mid-year intake 2027 closes 31 March 2027. International students studying the VCE, an Australian Year 12 or the IB in Australia or New Zealand apply through VTAC instead.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not needed if you meet 'citizenship or residency' (citizen, or 10+ years' resident, of a recognised English-speaking country) AND 'education in English' (final four years of secondary or higher education, or a full secondary qualification, entirely in English in a recognised English-speaking country, or a year of full-time study in a recognised bachelor's degree in an English-speaking country); or if you pass an approved secondary English subject, e.g. IB English or English B at grade 4 or higher (SL or HL), a C or higher in A/AS Level General Paper, General Studies, English Language, English Literature or English Language and Literature, or a 3 or higher in AP English Language and Composition or AP English Literature and Composition. Secondary English subjects count for 24 months if studied where English is not an official language and 60 months where it is.
